title: ExperimentRequest
description: A human-approved request to run one allowlisted experiment. Unknown fields are rejected.

target.description: Exact container name; must also be allowlisted for this type in config/experiments.json.

duration_s.description: Fault-active duration. Hard cap 30 s; the catalogue lowers it per type (service_crash, dependency_failure: 15 s).

approved_by.description: Human approver; required, no anonymous runs.
